Valcambi Platinum:
Valcambi started its operations in 1961. The Swiss Precious Metals company operates as one of the world’s largest precious metals manufacturing companies.
Valcambi mint became an established precious metals company after introducing its platinum bars with a delicate impression and mirror-like finish.
The Valcambi mint has a reputation for producing beautiful Platinum bullion products. Along with their unique identification like individualized serial numbers. Due to their high reputation and popularity, they are loved and trusted by all investors and collectors today.
Valcambi Platinum Bars:
The Valcambi Platinum Bar is a precious metal platinum bullion bar from Valcambi Mint. With Valcambi’s business model being precious metals refinery, the mint is highly reputed worldwide and is trusted for refining all precious metals.
The Valcambi Platinum Bar is considered one of the best on the bullion market. With the assay card and the assayer’s signature, defined purity, weight, and platinum content, you will not regret buying a platinum bar from Bullion Trading LLC.
The 500 g Platinum bar highlights :
It contains 500 grams (16.075 oz) of .9995 pure platinum.
Individual bars come sealed in a protective assay, and the assay contains the weight and authentication of the bar and metal content which verifies the bar.
The obverse features the Valcambi logo along with weight and its purity.
The reverse features “Valcambi Suisse.”
Each of the bars comes with a unique serial number for bar verification.
